vertebrae.utils.imports
=======================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.utils.imports

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Helpers for optional dependency imports.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: optional_import(module_name, install_hint)

   Import an optional dependency with a user-friendly error message.

   :param module_name: Module to import.
   :param install_hint: Installation instructions included in the error.

   :returns: Imported module.

   :raises ImportError: If the optional module is unavailable.
